title: Prime Focus' DNEG partners with Meta for 3D movie catalogue ahead of 2027 VR Glasses launch
summary: Prime Focus DNEG partners with Meta to supply 3D movie catalogue for 2027 VR glasses
detailed: Entertainment company Prime Focus Ltd on Tuesday (November 17) said visual effects and animation company DNEG has partnered with Meta to create a catalogue of popular movie titles in stereo 3D ahead of the launch of Meta VR Glasses in spring 2027.

ALSO READ | Ramayana’s strong box office start contrasts with Prime Focus share slide ahead of Q2 results
DNEG's Stereo team has been working in stereo 3D conversion for over 15 years and has delivered the world's first feature-length stereo conversion for a Hollywood movie.
Prime Focus founder and DNEG Global CEO Namit Malhotra said, "I'm excited and enthused to announce DNEG’s partnership with Meta to deliver never-before-seen 3D content for Meta VR Glasses.
The launch of Meta VR Glasses is set to be a game-changer and will give cinema fans a new way to experience their favourite movies in stunning 3D.
sentences: Entertainment company Prime Focus Ltd on Tuesday (November 17) said visual effects and animation company DNEG has partnered with Meta to create a catalogue of popular movie titles in stereo 3D ahead of the launch of Meta VR Glasses in spring 2027.
DNEG's Stereo team is currently working on several titles for the catalogue, including the recently announced conversion of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.
The project is being undertaken in collaboration with Meta, Lionsgate and director Francis Lawrence.
Meta VR Glasses feature a 5K Infinite Display built on micro-OLED panels, with 37 pixels per degree.
The display technology allows DNEG Stereo to create 3D versions of movies with cinema-grade clarity and detail, while also enabling immersive moments beyond conventional cinematic framing.
